ideas.text: An AI meditation app that whispers your screen-time stats during breathwork.
A sleep tracker that sends passive-aggressive recaps to your mattress.
A hydration coach that unlocks water only after facial analysis confirms thirst.
A wellness marketplace that bundles supplements according to your Slack sentiment.
A therapist bot that ends every session with a promo code for mushroom coffee.
A mood journal that converts feelings into a leaderboard.
A smart scale that evaluates your aura before your weight.
A yoga assistant that turns failed poses into personalized performance reviews.
An AI dentist reminder that generates cavity forecasts and investor-grade dashboards.
A self-care planner that books a sound bath the moment your webcam detects burnout eyes.
A grocery scanner that labels each snack as healing or future regret.
A biohacking app that gamifies cortisol spikes with collectible badges.
A digital twin that naps on your behalf and reports disappointing ROI.
A skin-care copilot that reads your pores like market signals.
An AI running coach that only compliments you if your route forms a convincing growth chart.
A meal subscription that uses computer vision to accuse you of emotional seasoning.
A wellness social network for people comparing resting heart rates like salaries.
A habit tracker that escalates missed streaks to an accountability shaman.
A mindfulness assistant that summarizes your inner child in quarterly business review format.
An AI sauna concierge that suggests hotter temperatures whenever your confidence drops.
An AI that detects when your Apple Watch has nagged you about standing 11 times today.
A bot that flags when you've closed your rings 4 days in a row by walking laps around your apartment at 11:58 pm.
An app that translates 'I worked out' into the 14-minute actual elapsed time including changing.
A tool that detects when your step count is fake because you carried your phone on a Roomba.
An AI that converts your VO2 max into the lie you tell on first dates.
A bot that flags when you've logged a 'mindful minute' that was actually 8 seconds.
An app that detects when your sleep score has been red for a month and you're still 'fine, actually.'
A tool that converts your meditation streak into the number of times you've fallen asleep during it.
An AI that flags when your fitness tracker has detected you're 'inactive' from across the room.
A bot that detects when you've muted your activity ring notifications for 14 days straight.
